propositions: Closing a bug ticket emits 'Ambiguous prefix' errors to stderr for bare 4-hex commit-subject fragments and then hangs for minutes after the close has already committed durably, caused by unbounded O(commits × tickets) alias scanning in metrics/blame.py without memoization or quiet resolution

The blame module's _find_fixing_commit walks entire branch history and re-resolves bug_id per commit without caching, causing each of ~2137 commits carrying 4-hex subjects to trigger ~0.26s of alias scanning, totaling ~9 minutes of wasted work after the durable close completes

Pass quiet=True at all scanner call sites in blame.py (_resolves_to and _commit_ticket) using the existing seam in _ids.py to suppress ambiguity errors for unqualified commit-subject candidates the user never supplied
Hoist loop-invariant bug_id resolution out of the per-commit loop and memoize ref-to-resolution mappings for the duration of one derive_caused_by call to eliminate redundant filesystem scans

Short-circuit before filesystem access by testing that a hex-quad ref can only resolve to the target if the target's canonical id starts with it, restricted to 1-, 2-, and 4-quad hex forms whose resolution control flow never reaches alias scanning

Deprecate bare 4-digit single-quad references in documentation (AGENTS.md and _ids.py module docstring) while preserving backward-compatible resolution and advertising the preferred forms (alias, 8-digit two-quad prefix, full canonical id, Jira ids)
